rationale: Ground truth has zero substantive concerns (just 'lgtm'), so recall is trivially full for both. X delivers a tight, well-organized review with grounded, actionable findings — the diffusion-mode residual bug, the untested base()-mocking regression, and version/CI-pin investigation — each with precise file:line refs and concrete code fixes.
